messages:
maria: Heads-up: two SI partners (OrionSys and BlueForge) both claimed ACME Corp from the marketplace intake this morning. Neither filed a pre-demo claim. Can we do a quick adjudication so sales doesn't call them both?

alex: ugh, saw this. ACME is in EMEA and BlueForge already demoed last quarter for an adjacent team. OrionSys is trying to expand into infra.

jordan: @maria can you paste the intake record id? I want to see which rep triggered the lead and the timestamp.

maria: intake id 2026-ACM-9182. Submitted 08:12UTC. BlueForge claim submitted 12:03UTC, OrionSys claim 12:07UTC. No champion listed on intake.

sam: Given the timeline BlueForge is first by 4 minutes. But if OrionSys has an existing relationship (past closed-won in 2022) we should consider that.

devon: OrionSys does have a closed-won on ACME in 2022 (db entry: OR-AC-2022-77). However that was a one-off infra module, not platform. Their eq team says they have an advocate in engineering.

ajob: pipeline-bot: flag: "SI-claim-conflict" on ACME. Suggested next step: quick ownership check + triage call within 24h.

maria: Proposal: short adjudication rubric -> 1) Existing closed-won relationship with SI (last 24mo) -> priority. 2) First valid claim with demo notes -> priority. 3) Customer-declared champion -> priority. If tie, run 1h micro-call with both SIs + our PS lead to decide.

alex: That rubric sounds reasonable. One nuance: marketplace-intake auto-claims from 'partner-connect' can be async; we should check whether BlueForge claim came from an automated integration or manual sales action.

jordan: I'll check logs. If BlueForge claim is automated and OrionSys manual, manual wins.

sam: Also add geography carve: if the SI has a named field rep assigned in the region, they get soft-priority but we still escalate to rubric if overlap.

maria: Updated rule set: 1) Manual claim w/ demo notes OR customer champion -> immediate priority. 2) Manual claim w/out notes + existing customer relationship (24mo) -> next. 3) Automated integration claim -> defer to manual claims. 4) If still tied -> 1h adjudication call.

devon: We should capture final outcome in intake record and tag both partner accounts, so billing/commission flows correctly. Also ping legal if there's any territory contract clauses.

ajob: pipeline-bot: created adjudication case ADC-1719876543, assigned to @maria, due 24h.

maria: Quick ask: @sam can you schedule a 30m micro-triage with OrionSys and BlueForge + PS tomorrow 09:30UTC? We want both SIs in the room to confirm scope, avoid friction.

sam: On it, booking now. Calendar invite will include the intake record and the rubric.

alex: One more ops item: we'll add a small field to the intake UI that marks "manual claim source" vs "api/marketplace" and a checkbox for "demo completed" so we reduce these conflicts. I'll open a tiny ticket.

jordan: Confirmed BlueForge claim came from portal manual submit (not API). They attached a one-line note: "Discovery done, needs platform demo."

maria: Given that, BlueForge wins per rule 1 (manual + demo note). But keep adjudication case open to confirm OrionSys historical relationship and coordinate co-sell motion if appropriate.

devon: I'll reach out to OrionSys to offer partnership overlay: if they have an advocate we'll propose a joint workshop so both SIs can be involved.

maria: Thanks everyone. Outcome: BlueForge primary for ACME (per manual claim + note). OrionSys given co-engage opportunity pending workshop. I'll update intake record and notify reps. :thumbsup:

pipeline-bot: adjudication case ADC-1719876543 marked RESOLVED (owner: maria). Tags: blueforge-primary, orionsys-coengage, marketplace-intake
